description: How a Tokscale client relates to a OriginLM discovery adapter. contained means Tokscale's session path must stay inside a OriginLM profile root. intentionally-different means adopting Tokscale's path would solve Tokscale's usage problem rather than OriginLM's access problem.

codex.note: Profile home is CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex. Tokscale reads sessions/ under that home.

claude.note: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude. CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR is local knowledge and wins when set.

gemini.note: GEMINI_CLI_HOME or ~/.gemini. Tokscale session files live in tmp/.

antigravity-cli.note: CLI conversations live under <gemini home>/antigravity-cli and follow GEMINI_CLI_HOME.

antigravity-extension.note: Extension databases stay under ~/.gemini/antigravity even when GEMINI_CLI_HOME is set.

antigravity.note: This Tokscale client reads Tokscale's own antigravity-cache, not the installed Antigravity profile.

opencode.note: Tokscale reads XDG data opencode/storage. OriginLM identifies the data directory. OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR is an additional local override.

cursor.note: Tokscale's cursor root is ~/.config/tokscale/cursor-cache. OriginLM discovers the Cursor installation directory.

copilot.note: Passive profile is ~/.copilot. Session databases are not opened. VS Code workspaceStorage chats are not separate installations.

grok.note: GROK_HOME or ~/.grok. Tokscale reads sessions/ and logs/unified.jsonl.

lmstudio.note: LM_STUDIO_HOME or ~/.lmstudio. Tokscale reads server-logs/ for usage; OriginLM only locates the home.

localOnly.note: Tokscale has no Ollama client. OriginLM keeps its own ~/.ollama profile.
